title: Version Update - Master RBC Transfer
author: Opentrons
materials: Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish Slot
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol package
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package, which includes the custom labware definition JSON file for the reservoir and plates, and updates the protocol from Opentrons API Version 1 to Version 2.

steps.title: Upload labware definition
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, upload the custom labware definition JSON file for the glass trough (Electron Microscopy Sciences), Omegaquant 96‑Well Plate, Blood Tube Rack, and 200 µL Tip Rack.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol script (compatible with Opentrons API Version 2) into the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the robot deck according to the deck map:

substeps.instruction: Slot 3 – Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish
Slot 5 – Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette (e.g., P50 Single‑Channel or Multi‑Channel) following the app’s calibration workflow.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to execute the Master RBC Transfer protocol.
